personalInfo.name: Carlos Gomez, MSc
personalInfo.title: Senior Data Engineer | Analytics Engineering | Data Platform Lead
personalInfo.summary: Senior data engineer with 14+ years building production analytics platforms at scale. Proven track record of owning end-to-end data infrastructure—from pipeline architecture to cost optimization—delivering measurable business impact: $89K/yr in cloud cost reductions, 50% faster incident detection, and zero-downtime migrations serving 200+ jobs across multiple live products.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer / Head of Data Department
experience.description: Sole owner of the Game Analytics ETL platform powering analytics for 3+ live games. Sets technical direction, ships all engineering work, and runs on-call for the entire data department.
achievements: Reduced Snowflake compute spend ~50% ($77K/yr run-rate), as measured by daily credit consumption dropping from 284 to 143 credits/day, by decommissioning sunset-game pipelines and right-sizing warehouse configuration.
Cut active data-warehouse storage 57% ($12K/yr), as measured by storage dropping from 82.6 TB to 35.3 TB, by executing four targeted cleanup waves and tightening data-retention windows.
Eliminated silent ETL failures across a 200-job platform, as measured by time-to-detect incidents dropping from days to minutes, by routing every job failure to Slack with full error context.

Built an automated test suite from 0 to 377 passing tests, as measured by zero production regressions during a 119-module framework refactor, by mocking all external services and establishing a test-first bug-fix workflow.

Closed a 31%-of-spend cost-attribution blind spot ($33.5K/yr), as measured by query-tag coverage over 73M queries, by implementing automatic per-statement JSON query tagging in the Snowflake execution layer.

Decommissioned 3 retired games safely, as measured by ~310 ETL files and 47 scheduled jobs removed with zero production incidents, by building a reversible deactivate-then-delete process with full audit logs.

Automated Accounting's monthly Snowflake cost allocation, as measured by per-game costs reconciling to the invoice to the cent, by building a Python tool (API + PDF fallback) replacing a manual spreadsheet process.
Remediated 2 SQL-injection vulnerabilities in production, as measured by security findings SEC-02/SEC-03 closed with regression tests, by replacing string interpolation with parameterized queries.

experience.title: Senior Analytics Manager
experience.description: Owned data architecture, governance, and analytics for marketing and live games.
achievements: Boosted marketing productivity 40%, as measured by campaign analysis turnaround time, by building a Python + SQL + AWS data pipeline ingesting AppsFlyer API data into a governed warehouse.

Identified $20K+/month in wasted marketing spend, as measured by ROAS/ROI analysis of live campaigns, by building fault-tolerant data pipelines with quality assurance that flagged 3%+ missing monthly revenue.
Cut manual analytics tasks 34%, as measured by department hours saved, by instrumenting cron-job automation and unifying data extraction with downstream reporting.
Reduced game data discrepancies 20%, as measured by month-over-month reporting accuracy, by implementing proactive data quality checks and pipeline-level validation.
Improved stakeholder data-use efficiency 13%, as measured by time-to-insight for business teams, by integrating Slack with reporting to surface the right data in the right channel.

experience.title: Product Manager (Analytics & Live Ops)
experience.description: Managed event design, mobile-game live operations, analytics, and process optimization.
achievements: Improved event setup efficiency 73% and cut human errors 33%, as measured by weekly event configuration throughput, by building tooling and process enhancements for the live-ops team.
Boosted D1 retention 7% and playing time 10%, as measured by A/B test results, by designing and shipping controlled experiments across the player base.
Cut dashboard creation time 30%, as measured by analyst hours per report, by designing and shipping a data warehouse with semantic-layer models (LookML).
Improved forecast accuracy to ±5% error, as measured by actual vs. predicted revenue variance, by building a statistical model that informed unit design and yearly event seasons.

experience.title: Associate Product Analyst
experience.description: Owned Battle Pirates analytics, in-game offer design, and pipeline modernization.
achievements: Improved analytics performance 96%, as measured by report generation time, by automating the reporting stack with shell-script-triggered ETL jobs.
Generated $1M+ in revenue over subsequent months, as measured by cohort attribution, by designing a re-engagement campaign that returned 40% of lapsed users and increased recurring players 10%.
Increased revenue 20%, as measured by monthly in-game purchases, by identifying universally-used but un-upgraded items and surfacing them via targeted offers.

experience.title: Software Consultant
experience.description: Developed a web platform for the BC Ministry of Education and led DevOps for continued deployment.
achievements: Cut new-developer setup time from 1 week to 1 hour, as measured by time-to-first-commit, by automating local environment setup and data obfuscation with SQL + Shell scripting.
Saved $70K/year, as measured by licensing and maintenance costs, by refactoring the platform front end with Bootstrap + JavaScript + jQuery.
Shipped a CI/CD pipeline for the BC Ministry of Education, as measured by deployment frequency and reliability, by building automation with Jenkins + Selenium + Docker.
